name: cloud-sessions
description: Working preferences and hard constraints for a cloud session, so one works with its sandbox rather than fighting it. Covers the egress proxy and its CA bundle, which parts of the GitHub API the proxy serves and which gh commands therefore fail, a container that reboots around every turn while its disk persists, repo scoping and add_repo's cross-owner rule, how a repo's own plugins and the account's user-scope ones each reach a session, the PR-subscription boilerplate's standing check-in request and why it is declined, and delegating to CI what the sandbox cannot run. Always on, and environment-agnostic: how a connector behaves lives in connector-conventions, a dependency, and one environment's own settings in a companion plugin.
